summary: A Flutter web or mobile dashboard: CitadelDS v1, routing with role-gated pages, responsive navigation, a data table kit and exact money. Every data surface has loading, empty, failed and not-configured states, and nothing is invented.

packageName.label: Dart package name
packageName.help: Lower case with underscores, e.g. acme_crm. It is the app's import name and cannot contain spaces.

appTitle.label: Application title
appTitle.help: Shown in the browser tab and the task switcher, e.g. Acme CRM.

platforms.label: Platforms
platforms.help: web for a web-only dashboard, or web,ios,android to build the mobile apps too.
